summary.zh: HanaKDE 首个公开版本带来完整的知识工作区、文件历史与内置待办工作台，并在保留这些二次开发能力的同时吸收 OpenHanako v0.449.0 的增强和修复。
summary.en: The first public HanaKDE release delivers the complete Knowledge Workspace, file history, and built-in Todo workbench while retaining these downstream capabilities alongside the enhancements and fixes from OpenHanako v0.449.0.

summary.zh: 在统一工作区中浏览和编辑多来源资料，使用分组搜索、标签、引用、预览和安全的文件操作来组织知识。
summary.en: Browse and edit material from multiple sources in one workspace, with grouped search, tags, citations, previews, and guarded file operations.

details.zh: 支持 Markdown 编辑、实时预览、表格、代码块、数学公式和 Mermaid 图表。
details.en: Includes Markdown editing, live preview, tables, code blocks, math, and Mermaid diagrams.

details.zh: 索引、搜索与资源树在桌面端、Web Open 和 Web Full 入口保持一致。
details.en: Indexing, search, and the resource tree remain consistent across desktop, Web Open, and Web Full entry points.

summary.zh: 从主工作区和文件树查看历史版本、比较差异并执行受保护的恢复操作。
summary.en: Inspect historical versions, compare changes, and perform guarded restores from the main workspace and file tree.

summary.zh: 持久化待办插件覆盖创建、组织、重复任务、提醒、自动化运行以及导入导出，并提供完整工作台界面。
summary.en: The persistent Todo plugin covers capture, organization, recurrence, reminders, automation runs, import and export, with a complete workbench UI.

sources.title: Add the built-in todolist plugin and complete workbench

title.zh: 打包启动与 Windows 运行链加固
title.en: Hardened packaged startup and Windows runtime

summary.zh: 补齐运行依赖完整性检查、服务就绪诊断和 Windows 安装包直连门禁，减少安装后启动失败和残缺运行时。
summary.en: Runtime dependency integrity checks, server readiness diagnostics, and direct Windows installer gates reduce post-install startup failures and incomplete runtimes.

sources.title: fix(platform): harden packaged startup and Windows gates

summary.zh: 通过保留合并拓扑的上游同步引入最新模型、更新器和稳定性改进，同时保留 HanaKDE 的 Knowledge、History、ResourceIO 与 Todo 所有权边界。
summary.en: A topology-preserving upstream merge brings in current model, updater, and stability improvements while retaining HanaKDE ownership boundaries for Knowledge, History, ResourceIO, and Todo.

details.zh: 包含 DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision 实验模型与声明图片能力模型的直接图像输入支持。
details.en: Includes the experimental DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision model and direct image input for models that declare image capability.
